decision.explanation: Two distinct individuals named Stephen O’Mara are mentioned across the documents. D1S2 explicitly states that Stephen Mary O’Mara was born on 5 January 1884. D2S1 refers to Stephen O’Mara MP, who was born on 26 December 1844. These are separate referents with no evidence of identity overlap. Both claims are directly supported by their respective sources and remain valid under the instruction to preserve distinct referents and avoid silent resolution of ambiguity.
